The OECD OPSI case says MauPass was launched in December 2020 and that e-services such as payment of Motor Vehicle Licence online, application for a learner's driving licence, and MoKloud digital safe access use it.

The OECD OPSI case says MauPass is a single window of authentication for government e-services of several ministries, with one account and user data validated against the Central Population Database including the ID number.
Government Online Centre statistics, cited in the OECD OPSI case, show hits on the MoKloud digital safe rising from 2,067 in January 2022 to 12,172 in September 2022.
